svg.text: LT30–S03 | Engineer decision and load interfaces
Neither load path is accepted. 75–85 kN is a supplier selection target, not a guaranteed peak-force limit.
A · Pivot-mounted cartridge — physical CAD candidate
Truck / cage
Bearing races / caps
Pusher / core / seat
Cheeks / crosshead
Critical decision: main bearing, housing, race retainers and covers must be accepted for axial impact and combined loads.
The steel hard ring bypasses the core at bottoming. It DOES NOT bypass the main bearing or limit bottoming force.
B · Independent articulated frame restraint — requirements only, no accepted anchor geometry
Separate truck anchor
Energy-absorbing safety link
Separate body-frame anchor
Engineer to define independent failure path, articulation, mounts and load factors before this alternative is modeled for release.
Event inputs: truck/body effective mass, relative velocity at failure, drive/brake continuation, yaw/roll and rail guidance.
Core request: certified force–travel curve over 20 mm, peak onset, rate/temperature variation, density, bloom and residual size.
Structure: full force/moment vectors; pin notches; pusher/contact; net cheeks; gussets, crosshead, diaphragms and global rails.
Overload: credible jam/bottoming load; secondary capture; combined normal vertical/lateral loads and fatigue assessment.
S03 · LT30 · 21 October 2026 · all dimensions mm · review geometry only
FABRICATION UNRELEASED
